about: The offertorium of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: There was a man in the land of Hus, whose name was Job, simple, and upright, and fearing God, whom Satan besought that he might tempt: and power was given him from the Lord over his possessions and his flesh; and he destroyed all his substance and his children, and wounded his flesh also with a grievous ulcer.
